definitions.sample_unit: One first-eligible checkpoint per training seed within each q. Two role mappings are not independent samples. Cross-q seeds are paired; no pooled independent-seed inference.
definitions.selection: stopping_record.development_stopping_criterion_satisfied; includes first eligibility at the C cap. All candidates remain in all_candidates irrespective of final results.
definitions.final_joint_pass: final pass_flags.overall_pass AND concentration.C_all.valid AND concentration.C_all_le_reference
definitions.statistics: Across candidate checkpoints within q/subset; arithmetic mean; sample SD ddof=1; numpy linear quantiles; IQR=Q75-Q25; min/max range.
definitions.full_domain: D2=[-(100+2q),100+2q], uniform stored grid spacing 0.5; role-pooled errors describe one shared actor.
definitions.tail: Unweighted pooled mean/max effort over abs(d)>=2q; theoretical effort is zero.
definitions.evenness: Mean/max abs(ehat2(d)-ehat2(-d)) over the complete recovery grid.
definitions.peak_d0: Analytic peak at d=0; relative error is 100*abs(ehat2(0)-g2(0))/g2(0). Actual grid maximum/location reported separately.
definitions.onpath_distribution: Deterministic shared-mean self-play, triangular density max(2q-|d|,0)/(4q^2) on [-2q,2q]; not sampled Beta-policy gap distribution.
definitions.onpath_primary: Original split Gauss-Legendre 64 nodes per half, recomputed on the frozen actor.
definitions.onpath_refinement: Frozen-actor trapezoid integration at steps 0.5,0.25,0.125,0.0625; sensitivity only, no candidate reselection.
definitions.onpath_expected_abs_error: abs(E_tri[ehat2]-g1), distinct from the cross-stage gap.
definitions.recovery_threshold: None. Continuous descriptive recovery metrics do not define recovery pass/fail.
